notes.title: Playtest only for test
notes.notes:
This version becomes a version of tests that will receive many changes periodically. The changes will not necessarily be present in the main game.
For a stable version play the main game.

notes.title: Version 0.799
notes.notes:
* Skill fixes.
* Scenario fixes.
* Quest fixes.
* Increased vendor inventory.
* Difficulty system balancing (evil).
* New translations (*1)

(*1) Note: I added French and Simplified Chinese. I tried my best to make sense of what is shown so that it is as coherent as possible, but there may be errors due to my complete lack of knowledge of these languages.

notes.title: Version 0.798
notes.notes:
* Major fixes to the scenario system
* Fixes to the equipment system
* Inventory improvements, now you can also specify the quantity
* Increased Stash size (*1)
* Network fixes and improvements
* Fixes to the quest system
* Fixes to the Settlement Teleport
* Fixes to enemies and the bot
* New enemies with their abilities
* Fixes to some elements in some scenarios
* Loading bar on the loading screen

(*1) Attention: Due to the increase in the size of the stash, its content will look "deformed", but no items should be lost, it is just an aesthetic fault. You will have to rearrange the items manually to fix it.

notes.title: Major Update 0.796
notes.notes:
* Improved graphical performance.
* New stage "Path of the brave".
* New locations.
* Several more quests.
* Several more enemies.
* New items.
* New stage theme (Interdimension).
* New NPC purchase (mystery box).
* PvP area available.
* Fixes to the bot companion.
* Fixes to monsters.
* Fixes to items.
* Fixes to stages.
* New music selection.

notes.title: A slightly more important update
notes.notes:
Version 0.795
* Various bug fixes.
* Refined item system.
* Bot improvements.
* More skills.
* Two new stages completed.
* New monsters.
* Underground level completed.

notes.title: Version 0.794
notes.notes:
* Major improvements to menus.
* Fixes and addition of more quests.
* Graphical optimizations.
* Translations.

notes.title: Important Minor Changes (0.793)
notes.notes:
Getting closer to final release. These changes include:
* Added a few more skills
* Fixed frame syncing
* Other miscellaneous fixes
* Stable networking

notes.title: Version 0.791 with a new level
notes.notes:
A new challenging level so you don't stay wanting more (I'm still wanting more myself, so I think others will be too).
* New hellish level
* Network changes and fixes
* Fixes to some inventory details
* Now the character doesn't stay with a pending click if he's attacking
* Fix to monster AI
* New hellish monsters with new skills for the new level
* Addition of some quests to complete

Although we still need to finish the quests and more character skills, we still have one more level to entertain ourselves. Also, in the next few days some new skills could be ready.

Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Multiplayer fixes only
notes.notes: In this version I only include fixes and improvements in multiplayer. But the next version will include a new scenario that I have been preparing for a while and is very necessary to complete an important part of the game.

notes.title: Network Fixes
notes.notes: Networking fixes and implementation of missing features for Steam (still needs testing).

notes.title: Balancing and Miscellaneous Fixes
notes.notes: Skill balancing, area and monster balance fixes. Some quest improvements. Item balancing and fixes.

notes.title: Items and fixes
notes.notes:
Added new equipment for the player and fixed and added some quests (still incomplete but can be completed).
I was going to wait to complete a few more things before uploading an update but I didn't think it was a bad idea to show what has already been done.

notes.title: Fixed a technical issue with files
notes.notes: A symbolic link was removed by export and was not reflected in the original file

notes.title: Fixes from the previous update
notes.notes: Fixed monster spawning in the Mines and some other bugs related to the scenario system.

notes.title: New map: Mines
notes.notes:
The Mines area is now available, although the next part is still to be completed.
The code that corresponds to the Scenarios (maps) has been cleaned up a bit, so there may be some errors in some maps. However, if there are, they will be fixed.

notes.title: Minor client bugfix (need test)
notes.notes: Fixed a bug in the client call function. Also multiplayer on Steam needs to be fixed as it would still not work.
